spaces.label: Code (Assembled)
spaces.description: The marketplace-assembly TEST SPACE. Its switcher, rail, workspace host, dock column, thread section and environment card are packs re-exporting the SHIPPED implementations from @fraym/ui (a granted pack external), so those fills are byte-identical to the built-in Code space by construction. Its COMPOSER is deliberately the odd one out: independent-composer, a second implementation assembled from the published PARTS (Composer, ComposerTips, the goal/usage surfaces, the capability adapters) and wired to the slim store channels — the owner-directed experiment that pressure-tests the parts decomposition. The acceptance gate is a live structural and behavioral comparison against the built-in Code space on the same session; any divergence is a finding against the parts surface, to be fixed in the part, not in this space.
